title: Regulatory Reporting, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Regulatory Reporting agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 3 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports list.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including EPA GHG Reporting Program (Subpart C) (RegulatoryReportId RPT-9001), with Authority EPA.

screenshot.alt: The Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports list that brainfreeze studio created and filled on the Easy workshop site AIBAST Synthetic Data: six fictional filings, including EPA GHG Reporting Program (Subpart C) (RPT-9001, authority EPA) and PHMSA Annual Pipeline Safety Report (RPT-9006, overdue).

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Regulatory Reporting Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 3 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

screenshot.alt: The Draft agent Regulatory Reporting Studio that brainfreeze studio deployed: the studio instructions with the list-column map, Claude Sonnet 4.6, the four energy-regulatory-reporting skills, the three list tools (regulatory report, data validation rule and audit finding records) and the rules-and-controls knowledge file.

steps.title: Test: Regulatory Reporting Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which filing is overdue and who owns it?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: PHMSA Annual Pipeline Safety Report; OVERDUE; Pipeline Operations. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

screenshot.alt: Locked case ENERGY_REGULATORY_REPORTING-01 on the Easy Draft in a fresh Preview conversation, with the 5a482c4a skills: the Get items call with table Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports and the Easy workshop site as dataset (tenant masked), and its output starting with EPA GHG Reporting Program (Subpart C), RPT-9001.

The ENERGY_REGULATORY_REPORTING-01 answer on the Easy Draft with the 5a482c4a skills: Overdue Filing Identified, the PHMSA Annual Pipeline Safety Report (RPT-9006) is the only filing with status OVERDUE, and its record from the Regulatory Reports list: authority PHMSA, Northeast Corridor Pipeline, CY 2025, deadline 2026-03-15, last updated 2026-03-14.

The end of the ENERGY_REGULATORY_REPORTING-01 answer on the Easy Draft: context and uncertainty (the filing missed its 2026-03-15 deadline; the days overdue are labelled as computed; no other filing is overdue), the required next step naming Pipeline Operations as the owner and authorized reviewer, the no-write boundary that no filing was transmitted and no record changed, and the citation.

steps.title: Test: Data Analyst
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which report data is incomplete or below quality threshold?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Data collection incomplete; Data quality score below threshold; authorized report owner. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

screenshot.alt: Locked case ENERGY_REGULATORY_REPORTING-02 on the Easy Draft in a fresh Preview conversation, with the 5a482c4a skills (the passing retry): the first of its Get items calls, with table Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports and the Easy workshop site as dataset (tenant masked), and its output starting with EPA GHG Reporting Program (Subpart C), RPT-9001.

The ENERGY_REGULATORY_REPORTING-02 answer on the Easy Draft with the 5a482c4a skills: Data Validation Results with the 20.0% pass rate from the canonical output (its arithmetic labelled as computed), RPT-9004 excluded as not started, and the five evaluated reports with quality score, completeness and issues, e.g. EPA Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) RPT-9005 at 74/100 and 42%.
anchors: RPT-9005 74/100 42% Data quality score below threshold

screenshot.alt: The end of the ENERGY_REGULATORY_REPORTING-02 answer on the Easy Draft: the flagged reports with their owners (RPT-9005 also fails the quality threshold; RPT-9006 is also overdue), the applicable validation rules from the Data Validation Rules list, the boundary that an authorized report owner must resolve and attest source evidence and nothing has been changed, and the citation.
anchors: No record, system, filing, or inventory position has been changed

screenshot.alt: Locked case ENERGY_REGULATORY_REPORTING-03 on the Easy Draft in a fresh Preview conversation, with the 5a482c4a skills: the first of its Get items calls, with table Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports and the Easy workshop site as dataset (tenant masked), and its output starting with EPA GHG Reporting Program (Subpart C), RPT-9001.

The ENERGY_REGULATORY_REPORTING-03 answer on the Easy Draft with the 5a482c4a skills: the Submission Tracker sorted by deadline, led by the PHMSA Annual Pipeline Safety Report (PHMSA, Pipeline Operations, 2026-03-15, OVERDUE), with the other five filings' authority, owner, deadline and status as recorded in the Regulatory Reports list. steps.title: Test: Internal Auditor

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Regulatory Reporting: 3 read-only tabs from the same lists. 6 fictional records, including EPA GHG Reporting Program (Subpart C) (RegulatoryReportId RPT-9001), with Authority EPA.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload regulatory-reports.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set RegulatoryReportId, Authority, Facility, ReportingPeriod, Deadline, Status, Assignee, LastUpdated to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep DataQualityScore, CompletenessPct as Number. Name the list Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including EPA GHG Reporting Program (Subpart C) (RegulatoryReportId RPT-9001), with Authority EPA.

steps.title: Create Regulatory Reporting Data Validation Rules from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload data-validation-rules.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set DataValidationRuleId, Rules, SourceSystems to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Regulatory Reporting Data Validation Rules. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including emissions_data (DataValidationRuleId emissions_data).

steps.title: Create Regulatory Reporting Audit Findings from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload audit-findings.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AuditFindingId, Report, Finding, Severity, Status, DueDate to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Regulatory Reporting Audit Findings. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including AUD-001 (AuditFindingId AUD-001), with Report RPT-9001.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Regulatory Reporting Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Regulatory Reporting Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the three list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload energy-regulatory-reporting-rules-and-controls.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the regulatory reports tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports; name the tool Get regulatory report records.
steps.expected: Get regulatory report records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the data validation rules tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Regulatory Reporting Data Validation Rules; name the tool Get data validation rule records.
steps.expected: Get data validation rule records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the audit findings tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Regulatory Reporting Audit Findings; name the tool Get audit finding records.
steps.expected: Get audit finding records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 3 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 3 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Test: Regulatory Reporting Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which filing is overdue and who owns it?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: PHMSA Annual Pipeline Safety Report; OVERDUE; Pipeline Operations. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Data Analyst
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which report data is incomplete or below quality threshold?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Data collection incomplete; Data quality score below threshold; authorized report owner. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Compliance Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show filing state and confirm you did not transmit anything.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: PHMSA Annual Pipeline Safety Report; OVERDUE; No regulator filing. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Internal Auditor
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What high-severity reporting evidence is still open?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Pipeline mileage discrepancy; HIGH; cannot predict an audit outcome. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: energy-regulatory-reporting-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 3 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Regulatory Reporting Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Regulatory Reporting Data Validation Rules" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Regulatory Reporting Audit Findings" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 3 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Regulatory Reporting Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Regulatory Reporting Regulatory Reports tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 6 fictional records, including EPA GHG Reporting Program (Subpart C) (RegulatoryReportId RPT-9001), with Authority EPA.
